title: FMS Aqua
description: A multi-farm management system for GreenFeed’s fish farms, covering production management, planning, materials management (MM), feed and supply inventory, and Solomon integration, with a reconciliation view that checks every warehouse issue against what each pond actually consumed. Built with Claude Code as a core part of the workflow.

title: FMS
description: A multi-farm management system for GreenFeed’s pig farms, covering production management, planning, materials management (MM), orders, sales and delivery, transportation, and e-invoicing, all integrated with SAP.

title: DBL Store
description: An online store for Dragon Ball Legends game accounts: customers sign in with Google, top up points, pick an account within their budget, and receive it instantly. Built end to end, from the storefront and API to deployment.
